news.headline: HAL Q2 Net Profit Grows 16% to ₹1,936 Crore but EBITDA Margin Contraction Triggers 2% Dip
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics reported a 15.97% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹1,935.64 crore for Q2 FY27 with revenue expanding 14.85% to ₹7,613.25 crore. However, operating profitability missed consensus as EBITDA margin compressed to 24.1% from 27.1%, causing the stock to drop 2% to ₹4,834.
news.impact: Margin miss forces a retest of the base support near ₹4,800; wait for consolidation before initiating new breakout setups.

news.headline: Bajaj Finance Launches ₹11,700 Crore QIP at Floor Price of ₹992.25; Shares Rise Over 3%
news.summary: Bajaj Finance opened an ₹11,700 crore Qualified Institutional Placement with a floor price of ₹992.25 and an indicative price of ₹1,025 per share. The launch follows a ₹5,799 crore warrant allotment to parent Bajaj Finserv, sending the stock up 3.32% to ₹1,110.70.
news.impact: Decisive volume breakout removes capital-raising uncertainty and establishes a solid floor above ₹1,050 for swing positions.

news.headline: Godrej Industries Rallies 12% as Temasek Invests ₹2,500 Crore in Godrej Capital
news.summary: Godrej Industries jumped over 12% to ₹1,087.20 after Temasek Holdings affiliate Jongsong Investments agreed to inject ₹2,500 crore into Godrej Capital, valuing the financial services entity at up to ₹28,000 crore while leaving Godrej Industries with an 80% controlling stake.
news.impact: Aggressive institutional holding-company valuation benchmark triggers a volume-backed breakout from multi-month consolidation.

news.headline: FPIs Pump All-Time Record ₹73,200 Crore in November, Powering Benchmark Consolidation
news.summary: Foreign Portfolio Investors registered historic net purchases surpassing ₹73,200 crore over the first eight trading sessions of November 2026, eclipsing the prior monthly record of ₹66,135 crore set in December 2023. The influx supported Nifty's hold at 25,299 as foreign funds reversed earlier outflows amid softer crude oil prices.
news.impact: Unprecedented foreign cash buying provides structural support, favoring swing pullbacks into rising 10-day moving averages.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Tanks 8% as Q2 Net Profit Halves to ₹54 Crore on Shipbuilding Loss
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard saw consolidated PAT plunge 49.9% YoY to ₹53.77 crore in Q2 FY27 despite revenue rising 12% to ₹1,249.19 crore. The shipbuilding division posted a segment operating loss of ₹6.08 crore, driving EBITDA down 31% and causing shares to slump 8% to ₹1,186.50 alongside a ₹3 per share interim dividend declaration.
news.impact: Severe execution margin contraction violates multi-week swing support, invalidating constructive cup-and-handle patterns.

news.headline: BEL Secures Additional ₹909 Crore Defence Orders; Reaffirms ₹55,000 Crore Annual Target
news.summary: Bharat Electronics disclosed new order wins totaling ₹909 crore for optronic pedestals, navigation units, and defense spares. Management reaffirmed its full-year FY27 order inflow guidance of ₹55,000 crore, supported by pending QRSAM clearance and the L&T-BEL consortium bid for the AMCA prototype project.
news.impact: Steady contract inflows bolster relative outperformance within defence, preserving support above ₹390.

news.headline: Nifty Realty Rallies Over 3% in Fresh Breakout Led by DLF, Godrej Properties and Oberoi
news.summary: The Nifty Realty Index emerged as the top sectoral performer on November 12, surging 3.4% amidst strong festive booking data and robust cash flows, outperforming benchmark indices as DLF, Godrej Properties, and Oberoi Realty gained between 3% and 5%.
news.impact: Decisive sectoral range expansion offers fertile territory for continuation breakouts and high-probability swing follow-through.

news.headline: Bahram Vakil Takes Charge as Trent Chairman Succeeding Noel Tata Post 25% Q2 Surge
news.summary: Bahram Vakil assumed the role of Chairman at Trent on November 12, succeeding Noel Tata, who retired as Chairman upon reaching age 70. The transition follows strong Q2 FY27 earnings where consolidated net profit jumped 25% YoY to ₹468 crore and the retailer marked the milestone launch of its 1,000th Zudio outlet.
news.impact: Orderly leadership handover provides stability as price forms a tight multi-week trading shelf near its 50-day average.

news.headline: Eicher Motors Scheduled for Q2 Results on Nov 13 with Royal Enfield Volumes Up 16%
news.summary: Eicher Motors will convene its board on Friday, November 13, 2026, to review and approve Q2 FY27 results. Street scrutiny will evaluate operating margins against Royal Enfield's quarterly sales volume of 3,78,669 units (+16% YoY) and VECV commercial vehicle shipments of 28,071 units (+28.2% YoY).
news.impact: Binary event trigger on November 13 will either resolve or reject the tight pre-earnings swing compression pattern.

news.headline: CG Power Assesses MPCB Waluj Closure Notice Following Record 44% Q2 Profit Expansion
news.summary: CG Power is engaging with regulatory authorities after receiving a Maharashtra Pollution Control Board closure notice regarding alleged environmental compliances at its Waluj facility. The regulatory overhang intersects with record Q2 FY27 operational strength, where net profit grew 44% to ₹409 crore and unexecuted order backlog surged 58%.
news.impact: Plant closure notice injects transient headline risk near ₹800 resistance, requiring price confirmation before trading new swing pivots.
